fusions.name: Downpour Stamp
fusions.desc: Brings the weather down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Cold Drip
fusions.desc: Flicks a drop that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Steady Fall
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Soak
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10. You regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
